models_evaluated: LLM agent with keyword-based note search

links.outcome: Agent output accuracy against human-annotated gold-standard labels, with and without keyword search
links.effect: Search-enabled agent achieved higher accuracy (92.4% vs. 83.5%) and reduced errors by more than half (41 vs. 89).
links.quote: The search-enabled agent achieved higher accuracy (92.4% vs. 83.5%) and reduced errors by more than half (41 vs. 89) by retrieving evidence from long, heterogeneous note histories.

unlisted_practices: Adding keyword-based note search tool to LLM chart-review agent to improve retrieval from long longitudinal notes

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating an agentic LLM chart review pipeline comparing baseline sequential review against a configuration augmented with keyword-based retrieval grounding/search.
